notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hey Fam,

It's the last day of the year and what better way to end it than to push your friends and family into trains and snow. So you can forget about 2020 as soon as possible.

In this update, we are bringing you a new game mode (Crown), and for a limited time, snow-covered Push Your Family. In the next update, we will be introducing cosmetics to Push Your Family. Anyone that plays the game before the winter event ends will receive some winter loot/cosmetics (in the next update).

Crown Battle Variant:
Crown is played on the same maps as Battle. In Crown, you need to (you guessed it) get the crown and keep it. If you get pushed or knockout you will lose it. The first player to reach 25 points wins. Good luck, and have fun!

TLDR:

 New Mode Crown
 Limited Snow/Winter Event
 Limited Event Cosmetics (You will receive these next update)


We wish you all a happy new year.

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

This patch should fix almost any issue that was reported to or found by us. We will be working on further improving Online Play (like joining games in progress). Furthermore, we will also start making new prototypes for new game modes. If you would like to see something specific, let us know!

Online Play

 Can now select a server in 'Online Play' menu
 Fixed no transition when not playing shuffle
 Added "waiting for players" screen
 Characters no longer freeze when a new player joins
 Fixed players popping/teleporting when someone is lagging
 Fixed game not ending when a player disconnects


If you are still experiencing issues, be sure to let us know.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304690/discussions/

Cheers,
Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
Yesterday we pushed an update that should have fixed the following issues in online play.


 Fixed not being able to join players that live in a different region, even though the same server is selected.
 Fixed Shuffle not showing the same map selection for different players.
 Fixed Total Wins not showing the same number for all players (causing game-breaking bugs).
 Fixed players being pushed or kicked over the outside walls in Quarantine maps.
 You now see what server you are connected to instead of "Closest".
 Fixed bug causing a lobby to lock after 3 people joined and left.


We noticed that not a lot of players are playing hybrid (joining an online game with one or more additional players). So we will be reworking the input to better accommodate players that join an online match solo.

We are also got some requests to be able to change keybindings in the options, so we will be working on that.

If you are experiencing any issues please let us know!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304690/discussions/

Cheers,

Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Only a push away from release
notes.notes:
Hello dear family members!

The release of Push Your Family is near!
We’re very grateful for your help! Your participation in the demo has bought us some more time to work on the game.

Now, we’re finalizing and tweaking the final bits - you know, giving that final kick and push 😉
We’ve stopped the timer on our clock, the game is coming in just 2 days! September 22nd!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37701794/f4401c37195c4b2c421b6ed1f73a4e0b6ba009a1.png

Mini-game still available
You can still participate in our mini-game to claim that prize!
And it’s also good practice for when the real pushing begins!
You can find the mini-game on our Steam page.
If you haven’t already, be sure to wishlist the game while you’re there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304690/Push_Your_Family/

Keep in touch with the fam
Thank you for your support and your anticipation for the game!
In the meantime, you can follow us on Twitter, TikTok and Instagram for some fun content alongside the release and afterwards. Don’t miss the family fun!
Get ready to Push Your Family soon!

Meteor Mug Team

notes.title: Help set a release date for Push Your Family!
notes.notes:
Push Your Family is coming to Early Access this September – the exact date depends on the outcome of the mini-game being released today!

The family is ready for the theme park, but the theme park isn’t quite ready for them! There aren’t enough bees, the rollercoaster loops need to be loopier, the carousel needs a speed test, the rocket ship still needs fuel, and more…

Can you help keep people entertained and buy us a little more time by playing the wipe-out game set up at the entrance? The more times you and your friends take a chance and fall (or get pushed) from the giant clock, the more time we’ll get for vital last minute polish - like making sure all the popcorn is popped, the mac and cheese is yellow enough, and the big red buttons press nicely! It's literally wipe-out-time-out, so hop on that clock!

Alternatively, if you can ‘beat the clock’ it will bring the release date closer! Perfect for those of you who just can’t wait to Push Your Family!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1326100/Push_Your_Family_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13

The Early Access release is the first step on the road to Push Your Family becoming a multiplayer party pack of many different game modes. We’re starting with Battle and Quarantine mode, with more on the way! Be the last family member standing in Battle, or try to get disinfected and escape from Quarantine.

[previewyoutube=0S2enDPMM5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Invite your friends, hop on the clock, and don’t forget to wishlist!
